subject: Insurance
title: The First Mortality Table
description: A short lesson to help you apply The First Mortality Table.

hook.text: In 1693, astronomer Edmond Halley built the first mortality table using birth and death records from Breslau, Germany.

buildup.text: Halley tracked how many people died at each age.

discovery.text: His table proved that younger people should pay less for annuities.

twist.text: Halley is better known for predicting his comet.

climax.text: Halley's table turned death from a mystery into a statistic. That single innovation made modern life insurance possible.

punchline.text: An astronomer mapped death by age.

quiz.question: Who created the first mortality table?
